method.timing: Production hydration call through one passive-effect completion. SSR, container setup, host identity checks, callback dispatch/validation and unmount are outside timing. Natural GC, no forced collections.
method.work: Static and event-heavy modes use the same button markup. Event-heavy adds click and mousedown capture/bubble callbacks on every row. Every root, row and callback is checked after timing.
method.order: Fresh Chrome process per block, seeded shuffled modes and renderer order, rotated renderer order per round, separate pages for all renderers.
method.units: Milliseconds per hydrated root. p95 describes sample averages, not individual hydration tail latency.
method.intervals: Exploratory paired block-bootstrap intervals from stats.mjs, not adjusted for multiple comparisons. Identical React control estimates run noise. This is not an allocation-rate or field responsiveness measurement.
